reconstruction_summary: Re-fit V2 steer-gain on FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 train fold per agent's tools/run_variants.py (bias=+0.00075, k=1.0843), then applied pred = k*(yaw_rate_pred_rads - bias) across all canonical Ford segments.
notes: Agent's V2 parameters (bias, k) were fit ONLY on FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 per their per-platform discipline; the canonical eval pools both Ford platforms, so applying Mach-E coefficients to F-150 Lightning likely loses fidelity on that platform. Reproduced exactly via deterministic interleaved 5-way split.
